missionPremise: Q1 is cortex-blocked (_inbox/2026-08-31_p91_q1_feasibility_measurement.md). The four items share a seat and file tree, not one piece of work. Item 4 is the only live customer consequence. artifacts/smartsite-mcp is integration-owned and is not edited.
completionPredicate: Done when (1) BLOCK regex matches BLOCK as well as BLK, proven by a fixture that fails the old pattern; worker mirror matches; issued-job audit is measured or declared unmeasured with its instrument; (2) GET /place/radius-search returns parcels for a point+radiusFt, cap is a stated number, truncation is a field not a resemblance; a radius that cannot bound refuses; (3) GET /place/street-search serves a bare street with locality required and declared truncation; (4) subdivision is a written refuse ruling, no widened regex, no route; (5) item 5 is cut or shipped. Not done: MCP vocabulary, smartsite-mcp edits, a subdivision acquire.
scopeBasis: Dispatch items 1-4 plus optional 5. In scope: artifacts/api-server and the records-request-worker mirror of the BLOCK parser. Out of scope: artifacts/smartsite-mcp, vocabulary rows, neighboring-context atom revival, store schema for subdivision, item 5 paint variants.

item4.pattern: BL(?:OC)?K — matches BLK and BLOCK, never BLKOCK
item4.fixture: BLOCK 3 / PECAN GROVE BLOCK 3 LOT 5 fail the old BLK(?:OCK)? pattern and pass the new one
item4.audit: read records_request_jobs.request_payload / scope_searched for legal text carrying BLOCK whose plan omitted a block term; if the store cannot be reached, unmeasured

item1.home: new route, not neighboring-context.atom.ts. That atom is a briefing digest keyed parcel+radius, registration-only, zero route callers. Stuffing a set search into it would wake a dormant mechanism.
item1.store: txgio_parcel jsonb geometry + bbox columns. No PostGIS. Candidate = bbox overlap with the circle bbox. Include if point-in-polygon or point-to-bbox distance <= radiusFt.
item1.cap: RADIUS_SEARCH_CAP = 50, stated. Fetch unique parcels, sort by distance, return min(n, cap). truncated=true when n>cap. cap, received, truncated, radiusFt on the wire.
item1.refuse: radiusFt<=0 or >5280; lat/lng invalid; candidate ceiling 2000 exceeded (radius_unbounded) rather than a silently short set
item1.falsifier: a response with hits.length===cap and truncated absent or false

item2.home: new route GET /place/street-search, not an overload of situs-search whose limit contract is 1-10 and whose prefix is house-number-anchored
item2.doesNotFallOutOfItem1: a radius around a geocoded street centroid is not everyone on Pine St
item2.require: locality (city or zip) parsed from q, or countyFips. Refuse bare_street_unbounded without one.
item2.match: normalized situs contains the bare-street token stream as a space-bounded needle, plus the street-type-stripped variant so PINE ST hits 908 PINE

item3.ruling: REFUSE. Do not acquire on this card. Do not widen the regex.
item3.reason: txgio_parcel deliberately does not store LEGAL_DESC (parse.ts: identity + situs only). cad_property.legal_description exists where CAD ingested it, and the shipped parser scored 0 of 6 on the repo fixtures including names that are plainly subdivisions. A wider regex produces confident wrong groupings. Acquire is a later card that must name a source and a cost per jurisdiction.

item5.reason: W2 probe facets_48021-34137.json already serves floodHazardFact.zoneSubtype = '0.2 PCT ANNUAL CHANCE FLOOD HAZARD'. The identical paint is a draw-variant / MCP-panel gap, not a missing serve field. smartsite-mcp is out of scope.
